name: Yunnan Shennong Agricultural Industry Group Co.,LTD.
summary: Yunnan Shennong Agricultural Industry Group Co., LTD. is a Chinese agricultural firm specializing in the manufacturing of animal feed, swine husbandry, and food processing. Its comprehensive operations span from livestock feed production and pig breeding to hog slaughtering and the distribution of fresh pork products across China. The company was established in 1999 and is headquartered in Kunming.
